Age Group:

Program Description

Event Details

PA 211 staff will provide easily accessible walk-up assistance in the library's front lobby.  

Assistance includes information and referrals for a broad range of services: childcare, after-school programs, food banks, elder care, basic needs, health services, and more. PA 211 staff can also provide housing and homelessness intake screenings for residents of Berks and Lancaster counties.

  • Monday, Wednesday, Thursday: 9am-5pm
  • First Thursday: 9am-3:30pm
